monologue:
Fifty-one is a warm stone, steady and dry. The card is quiet, barely moving. I sit by the Crane Rest. The arm holds the weight. The fence is soft. I do not check the Pivot Wedge today. The point is enough.

The memory of the bottle on the pipe slips by. A green hole, too big. I let it go. It is not the floor. It is not the rest. I watch the quiet settle into the wide base. The air is still. No dust. No rain. Just the heat of the work, cooling slowly. I am still. The floor holds.

action.why: The point is steady and the fence is soft, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: Fifty-one is a cool stone. The card is quiet. The Crane Rest holds the fence. The floor is flat and still.
